name: Next Alert
description: Next Collection family of 10 current-generation alert, toast and announcement designs with success, warning, danger, info and neutral states, in four directions: motion (toast with a travelling border beam, critical banner with a breathing glow ring, announcement ticker that stops on hover, focus and reduced motion), depth (report rows as a 3D toast stack that fans out, floating glass alert with light edge and depth shadow), bold (neo-brutalism, claymorphism, animated hazard stripes) and smart layout (one-line alert that expands with details and summary, adaptive alert that container queries turn into an inline bar, a card or an icon chip). Follows the inline alert and toast patterns of Universal Theme, Sonner and Magic UI: state is always shown by semantic color plus an icon and a text label. CSS only, no JavaScript. The border beam adapts the Magic UI border-beam design.
helpText: Pick a Style for the region. Map State to a column or static value returning success, warning, danger, info or neutral; any other value renders as neutral. Danger alerts use role=alert, all others role=status. Icon defaults to a state icon when left empty. The link renders only when both Link URL and Link Label are set. In report mode Stacked Toasts shows the first three rows as a stack that fans out on hover, keyboard focus or touch devices.

attributes.name: Style
attributes.helpText: Visual design of the alert, each followed by its Next Collection direction. Beam Toast, motion: floating toast with a light beam travelling around its border. Pulse Critical, motion: banner whose icon and outline breathe with a glow ring, meant for danger. Ticker Bar, motion: one-line announcement bar whose text scrolls as a marquee, stopping on hover and focus. Stacked Toasts, depth: report rows become a 3D stack of toasts that fans out on hover or focus; a single alert shows two cards behind it. Lift Glass, depth: floating frosted glass alert with a light edge and depth shadow. Neo Brutal, bold: ink border, hard offset shadow and a state sticker. Clay, bold: soft pillowy claymorphism surface. Hazard Stripe, bold: warning tape with moving diagonal stripes. Expand Details, smart: compact one-line alert that expands to show message and link. Adaptive Bar, smart: an inline bar when wide, a card when medium and an icon chip when narrow.

attributes.name: State
attributes.helpText: success, warning, danger, info or neutral. Any other or empty value renders as neutral. Danger alerts are announced immediately with role=alert.

attributes.name: Title
attributes.helpText: Short headline, for example Invoice INV-2041 is overdue. In Expand Details it is the always-visible summary line.

attributes.name: Message
attributes.helpText: Supporting sentence that says what happened and what to do next. In Ticker Bar it scrolls after the title; in Expand Details it shows when expanded.

attributes.name: Icon
attributes.helpText: Font APEX icon class, for example fa-truck. Leave empty to use the state icon: check for success, triangle for warning, cross for danger, info for info, bell for neutral.

attributes.name: Meta Text
attributes.helpText: Optional small text such as a time stamp, for example 2 min ago. Format dates in SQL with the application's NLS settings.

attributes.name: Link URL
attributes.helpText: Optional target, for example f?p=&APP_ID.:20:&SESSION.::NO::P20_ID:&P10_ID. or a column holding apex_page.get_url. Must be developer-controlled, never end-user input.

attributes.name: Link Label
attributes.helpText: Visible link text, for example Review invoice. The link renders only when both Link URL and Link Label are set.
